title: Hierarchical budget ledger
description: Objective: implement immutable hierarchical account allocation and return over the contract from task-7dc2e4870d7d4096a1be7b5991e50e94. Deliverable: packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-account.ts, its one-line .js bridge, and focused tests for root snapshots, parent-to-child allocation, child-to-current-parent return, balanced ledger entries, optimistic version fencing, derived subtree roll-up, replay, and legal closure. NOT in scope: work reservations, admission policy, usage measurements, settlement/quarantine, persistence, root authorization issuance, or package-root export. Hard dependency: task-7dc2e4870d7d4096a1be7b5991e50e94 must be DONE and its tests remain unchanged. Owned paths: budget-account.ts, budget-account.js, budget-account.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-account.test.ts.
definitionOfDone: Every accepted child allocation moves exactly the same integer units from parent AVAILABLE to child AVAILABLE, and every legal return performs the inverse without copying or sibling borrowing.

After each transition and replay, the derived root-plus-descendants AVAILABLE+RESERVED+QUARANTINED+COMMITTED total equals the authorized root amount plus explicit recorded overrun, with all direct buckets nonnegative safe integers.

Stale expected versions, missing/current-parent mismatches, insufficient AVAILABLE, duplicate identities, and illegal close states return deterministic frozen local issues with zero state or ledger-entry change.
A child closes only after returning direct AVAILABLE and proving direct RESERVED and QUARANTINED are zero; replay of canonical entries reconstructs the same deeply frozen state.
Both TypeScript files are <=250 physical lines, the bridge is one exact re-export line, and the focused verification command exits 0.
taskRails: Depends on task-7dc2e4870d7d4096a1be7b5991e50e94; do not modify its files or tests.
The root authorized amount is an already-authorized input fact, not minted by this kernel; no transition may raise it.
Production and test TypeScript files must each be <=250 physical lines; stage only the three explicit owned paths.
